title: Standardize kernel symbol versioning and unify operator registration across CUTLASS/Triton runtimes
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Over multiple rapid iterations we accumulated divergent operator registration paths and ad-hoc symbol names across our CUTLASS-based kernels and Triton integration layer. This makes mixed-toolchain images (gcc/clang/CUDA) brittle, increases image size due to duplicate symbols, and causes subtle runtime mismatches when switching model variants or using fallback kernels.

Goal: Consolidate operator registration into a single canonical registrar, add symbol versioning / naming conventions to avoid accidental collisions, and implement a lightweight compatibility shim so images built against different CUTLASS/Triton revisions remain interoperable. This should reduce CI flakiness, shrink GPU runtime images, and make rollouts between model variants safer.

Scope:
- Refactor operator registration APIs so runtime and plugin drivers use the same registrar entrypoints.
- Introduce symbol-version suffixing controlled by a build flag (e.g., KERNEL_SYMBOL_VERS=1) to avoid duplicate symbols when statically linking multiple kernel sets.
- Add a compatibility shim layer that provides renamed symbols for older toolchains (where feasible) and falls back gracefully.
- Update build matrix and CI to validate mixed-compiler + mixed-CUDA images (gcc-11/clang-15, CUDA 12/13, Triton 2.x/3.x, Cutlass 3.x).
- Add unit and integration tests to detect registration failures and symbol collisions early in presubmit.

Non-goals: Full ABI stability guarantees across major CUTLASS versions — out-of-scope for this ticket, but we provide migration helpers and docs to reduce upgrade friction.
acceptance_criteria: A single operator registrar is exposed and used by both runtime and Triton plugin codepaths (no duplicate manual registrars remain)
Build-time symbol versioning flag correctly renames kernel symbols and is covered by CI jobs
Compatibility shim provides fallback symbols for at least two prior release patterns and is tested in integration CI
CI matrix includes mixed-compiler + mixed-toolchain permutations and fails when symbol collisions or duplicate registrations are detected
PRs include perf impact analysis (binary size delta, startup latency) and a migration checklist for downstream teams
tasks: Sketch canonical registrar API and get approver sign-off (runtime/infra owners)
Implement registrar refactor in a feature branch and add compile-time flag for symbol versioning
Author compatibility shim with unit tests for renamed symbol paths
Add presubmit CI jobs for mixed-toolchain builds and a nightly integration job for the expanded matrix
Run internal migration on a representative model bundle and measure image size and launch latency
Write docs for operators migration and update release notes
comments: 2025-11-20 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after postmortem of flakey rollout to dedicated capacity; initial design doc linked. Action: prototype a registrar API that avoids per-plugin static registries.

2025-12-02 - Marco Chen: Spike complete. Confirmed two distinct static registrars in runtime and triton_plugin. Prototype register_all() approach reduces duplicate registrations but exposed symbol-name collisions when both CUTLASS v2 and v3 kernels are linked.

2026-01-08 - Leah Thompson: Design review feedback. Prefer build-time symbol suffixing over mangling at link-time to keep backtraces human readable. Requested perf number targets for binary size impact (<4% increase unacceptable).
2026-01-22 - Marco Chen: Implemented KERNEL_SYMBOL_VERS with cmake option; added rename wrapper in plugin layer. Posted draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2489
2026-02-05 - QA (Ravi Gupta): Integration tests failing on CUDA 12 / clang-15 combo with older CUTLASS artifacts. Root cause: missing weak symbol attribute on fallback shim — added fix in branch.

2026-02-18 - Marco Chen: PR updated with weak-symbol shim and added unit tests. Running nightly expanded CI matrix. Noted ~2.1% binary size reduction when duplicate symbols removed in a local image build (good).
2026-02-25 - Security (Nora Lee): Quick review — no new privileged APIs. Recommend adding a linter test to prevent accidental export of C symbol names without prefix. Adding as follow-up.
2026-03-04 - PM (Diego Morales): Confirmed this is on the path for runtime-1.22. Please ensure migration docs include steps for Dedicated customers who vendor their images.
2026-03-10 - Marco Chen: Current status - feature branch green locally, CI matrix still stabilizing (two flaky combos). Next: address flaky combo and submit mainline PR.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: symbol suffixing increases symbol count but avoids post-link rewriting. Link-time solutions (objcopy, symbol maps) were rejected due to fragile toolchain differences across distros.
Plan B if shim approach fails: ship a separate compatibility pack and use dynamic loading for older kernels. This may increase operational complexity for Dedicated customers.
Follow-on work: introduce linter to enforce kernel symbol prefix and add a release checklist entry for CUTLASS/Triton upgrades
